class squirrel.schemas.notebook.RenameNotebookRequest(**data)[source]

Bases: BaseModel

Body for PATCH /notebooks/{notebook_id}. Both fields are optional and independently nullable-by-omission — the frontend’s rename modal sends whichever of name/description actually changed, so the service layer only touches the fields that were explicitly provided rather than clobbering the other one back to empty.

Parameters:

  • name (str | None)

  • description (str | None)

model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = {}

Configuration for the model, should be a dictionary conforming to [ConfigDict][pydantic.config.ConfigDict].

class squirrel.schemas.notebook.RunCellRequest(**data)[source]

Bases: BaseModel

Run a cell against some subset of the notebook’s attached data sources.

A manipulation-flavored question (e.g. “dedupe by customer_id”) is not a distinct cell type — it’s answered by the same “question” pipeline, which decides internally whether a chart or a saved view fits better.

Parameters:

  • type (Literal['eda', 'question', 'dashboard', 'markdown'])

  • query (str | None)

  • data_source_ids (List[str] | None)

model_config: ClassVar[ConfigDict] = {}

Configuration for the model, should be a dictionary conforming to [ConfigDict][pydantic.config.ConfigDict].
